title: fix(metadata-protocol): a package publish judges each draft with the batch's own extension drafts folded onto their targets
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMscMg6AKHasj3ZXEDorLPH)_
Fixes #33152

Clause-②: no — removes a false refusal the published contract already denies: the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` changelog entry 0c24898 states "a package publishes as a self-consistent unit — `publishPackageDrafts` judges each draft against the batch's own pending declarations", and the batch's `object_extension` drafts were the pending declarations left out. No exported type or signature changes (`dist/index.d.ts` carries no `pending` member at all; the changed type is module-internal).
Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type changes; `os build` already accepts these packages, and the batch door now gives the same verdict.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：批量发布（`publishPackageDrafts`，以及草稿读取时给出的“发布预判”）收集待发布集合时，现在也收集同包的对象扩展草稿，并在判定时把这些草稿的字段并到被扩展对象上。
- 为什么改：同一包里一个扩展草稿加的字段，被另一个草稿的公式或跨对象引用读到时，会被误判为 `unknown field`，整批回滚；`os build` 却接受。作者只能按顺序逐个发布。
- 风险与回滚：只会让“同批扩展新增的字段”变得可解析，不会让任何原本不存在的字段通过；回滚即还原本 PR 的两个源文件改动。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`（`foldPendingObjectExtensions` 及其在 `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` 中的两处调用）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts`（收集器多了 `objectExtensions`）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`（新的 #33152 用例）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts -t 33152`，预期 3 个用例全部通过（两个“一次批量发布成功”，一个“引用不存在字段仍被拒、整批保持草稿”）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `collectBatchPendingDeclarations` (`protocol-publish-batch.ts`) collects the batch's `object_extension` drafts into a new `objectExtensions` entry of the pending set. The routing table `CLOSURE_CONTEXT_KEY_BY_TYPE` gains the row `object_extension: 'objectExtensions'`; its `satisfies` clause now names `RuntimePendingDeclarations` (the context collections plus this one key), so the drift guard and the completeness assertion over `RuntimeStackContext` are unchanged.
- `RuntimePendingDeclarations` (module-internal) is `RuntimeStackContext` plus an optional `objectExtensions`. It is not a context collection: the live `objects` the gate reads are already served (the registry folds every published extension onto its target), so a pending extension is folded the same way rather than joining a collection of its own.
- `foldPendingObjectExtensions` (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts`) adds each pending extension's `fields` to its target in the object universe, merged by name with a later writer replacing the whole field: the registry's `mergeObjectDefinitions` field merge, and the one part of it `objectsAsServed` folds for the build. It runs after `mergePendingDeclarations`, so a target that is itself a draft of the batch is folded too. On an `object_extension` write the written extension's own draft is left out (`withoutTarget`): the rules fold the written entry themselves, onto the target without the written package's extension (#33072).
- The draft read's publish verdict (`draftPublishVerdict`) uses the same collector, so it gives the same answer.
- Docblocks that described the defect (`objectExtensionWriteFold` in `protocol-authoring-gate.ts`) now describe the fix.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[#33152]` on the file's real rig (better-sqlite3, the real ObjectQL engine and protocol). The base gains `crm_region` and `crm_site` (a lookup `region` to the region); the pair publishes in one batch:
  - LIT: extension drafts `{ extend: 'crm_region', fields: { tier__c } }` and `{ extend: 'crm_site', fields: { tier_label__c: formula "record.region.tier__c + '!'" } }`. Expected `outcome: 'published'`, both rows active, both fields served.
  - LIT: the same region extension draft beside an object draft `crm_custom_deal` whose formula hops `record.region.tier__c`. Expected `outcome: 'published'`.
  - CONTROL: the sibling adds `tir__c` instead. Expected `outcome: 'refused'`, the site row's `code` `INVALID_METADATA` naming `tier__c`, both rows still drafts, and the region not serving `tir__c`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-drafts-closure.test.ts` (the #10377 closure harness), new top-level describe: the fold keeps the target's fields and adds the draft's, does not mutate the live entry, folds onto nothing when the target is in no universe, honours `withoutTarget`; and `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` refuses an object's hop into the region's `tier__c` (`code` `INVALID_METADATA`, `status` 422) without the sibling extension draft and accepts it with it.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope is the batch half of the card. The card's per-item object-door case (an object's own formula reading a field its package's published extension adds; the object save's destructive-change guard reading such a field as removed) is not in this PR: the object door judges the WRITTEN body, which replaces the served object in the snapshot, so it is a different function from the batch's universe. Reported to the seat as a follow-up.
- The fold is additive, as `mergePendingDeclarations` is. For a target the package already extends in a published extension, the draft's fields are folded over the served target, which still carries the published extension. A sibling's reference to a field the draft drops therefore still resolves (it did before this PR too). The single-item extension door narrows that case (#33072); the batch does not yet. Not measured; noted.
- Two comments in `@objectstack/lint` (`validate-expressions.ts`, the `runtimeWriteType` docblock; `authoring-rules.ts`, the expression rule's `surfaces` comment) and the last bullet of the unreleased `.changeset/33072-object-extension-door-formula.md` still say the batch refuses this case. They are outside this claim's file surface and left for the seat.
- Measured while writing the CONTROL: a formula that hops through a lookup the same extension adds (`record.region__c.tier__c`, `region__c` declared in the written extension, `tier__c` existing nowhere) was published by the batch. That is a different path (a hop through an extension-added lookup); reported to the seat as a finding.
